name: Starnheim
description: The golden realm of heroes, whose light shines above Istfell and which Valkyries grant entry to.

pages_say.description: A realm whose light atop the World Tree will guide Kaya.
The paradise realm of the Valkyries and the gods, which no living mortal has entered.
The paradise at the top of the World Tree where the honored dead feast with Valkyries.
The Valkyries' realm that Tibalt attacks with Koma.
The endless hall where heroes of every clan feast and drink for all time.
The golden realm of heroes, whose light shines above Istfell and which Valkyries grant entry to.
The heroic realm where souls feast and fight.
The realm whose light might color the snow in the new realm.
